overview.en:
Read spreadsheets and update values, formulas and structure through Google’s official Sheets API with your Google account.

Inspect spreadsheet structure and values before changing cells or formulas. Make ranges and assumptions explicit, and describe how the result can be checked.

Select Connect in the plugin details. One Google account connection is shared by every installed Google plugin; granted permissions still limit each service.
overview.zh-CN:
通过 Google 官方 Sheets API 与已连接的 Google 账号读取表格并更新数据、公式与结构。

修改单元格或公式前先检查表格结构与数据，明确范围和假设，并说明如何核对结果。

在插件详情中选择“连接”。所有已安装的 Google 插件共用一次 Google 账号连接，各服务仍受已授予权限的限制。

starterPrompts.en: Summarize this sheet and identify the key metrics and data gaps.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 总结这张表，识别关键指标与数据缺口。

starterPrompts.en: Review these formulas and explain any errors or inconsistent references.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 检查这些公式，解释错误或不一致的引用。

starterPrompts.en: Prepare an update to this table with the requested calculations.
starterPrompts.zh-CN: 为这张表准备包含所需计算的数据更新。

descriptions.en: Use Google Sheets in Ghast. Read spreadsheets and update values, formulas and structure through Google’s official Sheets API with your Google account. 通过 Google 官方 Sheets API 与已连接的 Google 账号读取表格并更新数据、公式与结构。
